result.markdown: --- title: "Curriculum Vitae" description: "Positions, education, leadership, and service." --- Chennai, India · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=9LJsXtMAAAAJ&hl=en) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stat-absk/) ## Profile Biostatistics leader pairing hands-on industry development and FDA regulatory experience across the drug-development lifecycle with a strong academic and methodological foundation. Currently Senior Manager, Biostatistics at Pfizer (Associate Director–equivalent) and a member of the Data Science & Analytics India leadership team, leading a team of statisticians across global Oncology and Inflammation & Immunology programs. Former FDA Oncology Center of Excellence primary reviewer with hands-on NDA/BLA experience, product-labelling negotiation, and pioneering use of real-world evidence and external-control cohorts. ## Experience ```{=html} ``` ::: {.cv-entry} [Jun 2024 – present]{.cv-when} [Senior Manager, Biostatistics]{.cv-what} — Pfizer Healthcare India Pvt. Ltd., Chennai, India - Associate Director–equivalent statistical leader on the Data Science & Analytics India leadership team, shaping statistical strategy across global Inflammation & Immunology development programs. - Lead and develop a team of statisticians — building talent, strengthening statistical capability, and fostering a culture of scientific excellence. - Build enterprise capability in real-world evidence and target trial emulation, partnering with Statistics leadership to advance next-generation evidence generation. - Advance modern quantitative methods across programs, including endpoint consolidation, real-time trial monitoring, and reproducible quantitative science. ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [May 2022 – May 2024]{.cv-when} [Manager, Biostatistics]{.cv-what} — Pfizer Healthcare India Pvt. Ltd., Chennai, India - Trial-statistician leadership across Inflammation & Immunology programs spanning pediatric ulcerative colitis and inflammatory bowel disease, with medical-affairs support and priority programs in atopic dermatitis, asthma, and COPD — from study design through regulatory deliverables. - Oncology statistical leadership on targeted-therapy programs across non-small cell lung cancer and melanoma, spanning protocol design, analysis planning, and submission-supporting deliverables. ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [Feb 2020 – Apr 2022]{.cv-when} [Mathematical Statistician (Primary Reviewer)]{.cv-what} — U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Oncology Center of Excellence, Silver Spring, MD, USA - Primary statistical reviewer for NDA, BLA, and IND submissions across multiple oncology indications, delivering independent assessments that informed regulatory decisions and product labelling. - Reviewed applications spanning gastric and gastroesophageal cancers, cholangiocarcinoma, and additional solid-tumor indications, as well as an oncology biosimilar and a supportive-care (otoprotection) program. - Led sponsor–agency interactions and labelling negotiations, translating statistical findings into clear regulatory positions. - Contributed to one of the FDA's early evaluations of real-world evidence and external-control cohorts through review of a pediatric neuroblastoma program. ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [Aug 2019 – Jan 2020]{.cv-when} [Biostatistician]{.cv-what} — Nemours Children's Health System, Jacksonville, FL, USA - Led end-to-end statistical strategy for investigator-initiated pediatric studies across multiple therapeutic areas — concept and design through analysis, interpretation, and publication. ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [Aug 2017 – Jul 2019]{.cv-when} [Assistant Professor of Statistics (tenure-track)]{.cv-what} — University of Northern Colorado, Greeley, CO, USA - Taught graduate and undergraduate statistics, mentored students, and led applied and methodological research. - Served as statistical consultant on cross-disciplinary research collaborations across the university. ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [Aug 2012 – Aug 2017]{.cv-when} [Graduate Assistant & Instructor]{.cv-what} — University of Florida, Department of Statistics, Gainesville, FL, USA - Instructor, teaching assistant, and statistical consultant while completing PhD research. ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [Jun 2011 – Apr 2012]{.cv-when} [Statistician]{.cv-what} — Cytel Statistical Software & Services Pvt. Ltd., Pune, India - Supported early-stage sponsor studies through statistical programming, analysis, and study-support activities. ::: ## Education ::: {.cv-entry} [2012 – 2017]{.cv-when} [PhD, Statistics]{.cv-what} — University of Florida ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [2009 – 2011]{.cv-when} [MSc, Statistics]{.cv-what} — University of Calcutta ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [2006 – 2009]{.cv-when} [BSc, Statistics]{.cv-what} — University of Calcutta ::: ::: {.cv-entry} [2025]{.cv-when} [Leadership Development Programme]{.cv-what} — IIM Ahmedabad (for Pfizer) ::: ## Professional leadership & scientific service - Scientific Committee Member — International Indian Statistical Association (IISA) - Council Member, Biostatistics Council — Indian Society for Clinical Research (ISCR) - Mentor, Pfizer statistics internship program - Biostatistics workshops — Loyola College and SSKM Hospital, Kolkata ## Selected presentations - IISA Annual Conference — 2024, 2022 - Novartis Sankhya — 2023 - International Triennial Calcutta Symposium on Probability & Statistics — 2018, 2015 - ASA Joint Statistical Meetings (JSM) — 2017 ## Research focus Much of my recent work sits in two places: using **target trial emulation** to bring observational data to bear on questions trials answer slowly or not at all, and **endpoint and estimand strategy** — deciding what a trial should measure before arguing about how to analyse it. ## Publications {{< tally 15 >}} peer-reviewed journal articles · 315 citations (as of July 2026) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=9LJsXtMAAAAJ&hl=en) ```{=html} ``` ### 2026 1.
